info.name: Suspicious Minds
info.plot: Amber, una brillante ladra, arriva su Isla Esperanza con l'obiettivo di rubare la preziosa Tiara di Santa Águeda, ma il suo piano è complicato dall'inaspettata ricomparsa di Rui, il suo ex compagno che non ha esitato a tradirla in passato. Ora, la cosa più difficile sarà fidarsi l'uno dell'altra e accettare che l'amore potrebbe essere il più grande tesoro della loro vita.

episodes.name: The Santa Águeda Tiara
episodes.plot: After Rui's death, Amber, an expert thief, arrives on Isla Esperanza as a bridesmaid at the wedding of a millionaire heiress. Her goal? To steal the legendary Santa Águeda's tiara, a highly guarded jewel. As she executes her plan, she will face ghosts from her past and unexpected enemies in a world of betrayals and secrets where there is only one rule: never fall in love.

episodes.name: Will You Join Our Gang?
episodes.plot: After a failed robbery attempt, Amber and Rui are trapped on Isla Esperanza. Security is heightened, and every move is monitored. The thieves recruit allies for a new plan. With old grudges between them and the tiara under maximum protection, they must choose whether to continue as rivals or join forces before it's too late.

episodes.name: The Fingerprint
episodes.plot: Villegas and Judith keep a close eye on all the wedding guests. The gang must manipulate the security arches and execute the first part of the plan. The group faces the appearance of someone unexpected who could put everything at risk. Everyone agrees to work as a team to carry out the robbery successfully.

episodes.name: You and Me, Let's Go to the Party
episodes.plot: An unexpected fire in the jungle endangers the gang, while Judith closes in on the suspects. Coordinating their actions to carry out the robbery, the thieves must ensure that the bride and groom's dance is the key moment to carry out their plan. At the same time, Saveria and Nacho begin their own investigation and uncover evidence that could unmask them.

episodes.name: Until Death Do Us Part
episodes.plot: Amber and Rui launch the "Lazarus Plan," a risky move that could complicate things even further. Tensions among the gang rise, and old grudges threaten to derail the robbery. Making a single mistake could cost them their lives. Meanwhile, Villegas and Judith are certain they'll catch them.

episodes.name: D-Day
episodes.plot: D-Day has arrived. The gang executes their plan to seize the valuable Santa Águeda's tiara. Everything is calculated down to the last detail, and the thieves are prepared to anticipate Judith and Villegas. But in robberies, unforeseen events always occur: an unexpected betrayal could mean the loot could change hands at the last minute.
